_about: More weapons for the sandbox (decision 0013). Each is drawn alone, upright, with a simple solid silhouette, because that is what the 3D step handles well. Same fragments as v0.

subjects.subject: A large two-handed greatsword standing upright point up, broad straight steel blade, long leather-wrapped grip for two hands, wide crossguard shaped like two leaves, round bronze pommel, chunky readable proportions.
A one-handed flanged mace standing upright, head up: a heavy iron head with six thick blunt flanges, short sturdy wooden haft, leather grip, iron ring at the base.
A two-handed war hammer standing upright, head up: a big square stone hammer head bound with iron bands, a thick wooden shaft with green cord wrapping, simple and heavy.
A rough wooden club made from a pale twisted tree root standing upright, thick knotted head at the top, narrow handle wrapped in brown leather at the bottom.
A curved single-edged sabre standing upright point up, broad polished steel blade with a gentle curve, small round brass guard, dark green wrapped grip, brass pommel.
A slim thrusting sword standing upright point up, narrow straight steel blade, a bronze cup-shaped hand guard, dark leather grip, small round pommel.
A halberd standing upright: a long wooden pole with an axe blade on one side, a short spike on top and a hook on the back, steel head, leather wrap below the head.
A wizard's walking staff standing upright made of pale smooth twisted wood, the top curls into an open loop holding a round warm gold glowing crystal, green cord wrapping in the middle.
A short magic wand standing upright, a straight tapered stick of pale polished wood with a spiral groove, a small gold crystal tip, a brown leather grip at the thick end.
A small throwing hand axe standing upright, head up: short curved wooden handle, one compact steel blade with a simple leaf engraving, leather cord around the grip.
A short broad-bladed sword standing upright point up, leaf-shaped steel blade, small bronze guard, wooden grip with a brass ring, round pommel, sturdy and simple.
A tall kite-shaped wooden shield seen from the front and slightly to one side, painted cream with a large green tree emblem, thick steel rim with rivets, solid and flat.
A small round steel buckler shield seen from the front and slightly to one side, a raised round boss in the centre, a ring of rivets, polished grey steel with a bronze rim.
A wooden hand torch standing upright, a thick stick with a head wrapped in cloth and bound with iron bands, a compact stylised orange flame on top with simple solid shapes.
A miner's pickaxe standing upright, head up: a sturdy wooden handle and a thick double-pointed iron head, leather wrap at the grip.
A plain fighting quarterstaff standing upright, a long straight pole of dark polished wood with brass caps on both ends and a leather wrap in the middle.
